curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach who must obey signals, what green and steady yellow mean, and why you never speed up for a yellow.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: One card per signal rule; a contrast card for an officer versus the signal.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about what to do on green and on a steady yellow.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain the full stop on red, right on red, and the manual's freeway-exit figure.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each red-light rule; contrast cards for yellow versus red and the right-on-red limits.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about stopping and turning right on red.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach flashing red and yellow lights, then the red, yellow, flashing yellow and green arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each light and arrow; contrast cards for flashing red versus flashing yellow and red versus flashing yellow arrows.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions that match a light or arrow to the right action.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Explain dark signals, uncontrolled intersections, T intersections and what right-of-way law really says.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each intersection rule; contrast cards for ties, T intersections and dark versus uncontrolled.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Scenario questions about who yields at an intersection.

curriculum_unit_hints.session_strategy: Teach yielding in crosswalks, school crossings, stopped vehicles and pedestrian-activated signals.
curriculum_unit_hints.flashcard_strategy: Cards for each pedestrian rule; contrast cards for the pedestrian signal colors.
curriculum_unit_hints.quiz_strategy: Questions about crosswalks and pedestrian signals.
